# hackerone_policy (Resource)

Manages the security policy text for a HackerOne program.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy` (String) The program policy, in Markdown.
- `program_id` (String) Numeric ID of the program whose policy this manages. Use the `hackerone_program` data source to resolve a handle to an ID.
